text:
Olivia: Greentech raised a dispute on INV-2026-07-10. They claim a ~12m window during regional maintenance routed traffic off their reserved pool and they were billed burst rates. Asking for refund + SLA credit.

Mark: tagging @priya for attribution recon. Can you pull assignment logs for 2026-07-10T04:12Z-04:24Z? They say the traffic should have stayed on greentech-ded-3.

Priya: grabbing logs now. quick peek shows routing flipped to fallback-host during a cluster upgrade because an autoscaler probe marked node as "maintenance" incorrectly. looks like reserved commit wasn't honored for about 12 minutes.

Priya: snippet:
```assignments:
2026-07-10T04:13Z -> fallback-host
2026-07-10T04:25Z -> greentech-ded-3
```
Estimated extra burst = $12,940.

Finance-bot: Policy: automatic SLA credits <= 15% of monthly commit. Cash refunds > $5k require director + legal approval; credits preferred for recurring customers.

Mark: Greentech is a multi-year committed account. Recommend refund for the exact overcharge and a goodwill SLA credit of 8%. Will propose cash refund since CFO requested it.

Priya: charge ids for the window: CHG-13200, CHG-13201. Reconciliation worksheet in ticket #4355 with per-minute breakdown. Duplicate meter lines from probe retries contributed ~40% of the overage.

Olivia: note for customer message: be concise — corrected invoice, refund + SLA credit, root cause (autoscaler probe mislabel), mitigation steps. Do not promise future credits beyond this.

Mark: @sam can you approve a cash refund of $12,940 + 8% SLA credit applied to next billing cycle? Legal to confirm contractual language on refunds.

Legal-bot: Reviewed SOW 5.4. Contract allows "credit or refund" for failure to provide committed capacity. Recommend written amendment to note the cash refund and the mitigation steps.

Sam: Approved for the refund amount and 8% SLA credit. Legal acked. Please include remediation note and the ticket #4355 into the customer communication.

Priya: engineering ops note  ops-bot: we've rolled a fix to change probe labeling to avoid maintenance false positives. Patch deployed to eu-west-2. We'll also add an audit log flag for future recon.

Ops-bot: Deployment log: patch-2026-07-10-ops-44 applied at 2026-07-10T09:02Z. Monitoring shows no regressions.

Olivia: Action items: 1) Finance run refund $12,940 (CHG-13200,CHG-13201) cash, 2) apply 8% SLA credit to next invoice, 3) send customer note with ticket #4355 and remediation summary, 4) close the dispute once refund posts.

Priya: I'll upload detailed recon and attach logs to ticket #4355.

Mark: Great work. @olivia please proceed with `/process-refund CHG-13200,CHG-13201 amount=12940 ticket=4355 note="Greentech - reserved commit misattribution during maintenance"` and record approvals.

Olivia: executing now and drafting the customer message. Will update when refund completes. :white_check_mark:
